support.note: Validated live on 2026-10-10: F1 25 v1.26 on PS5, Austria race. notes: Community-documented protocol (docs/research/gt7-protocol.md); not yet validated on a real console.

No lap distance in the protocol: integrated from speed x tick time; drifts ~1 %, unanchored until the first start/finish crossing seen while moving (race lap 1 after a standing start has no distance).

No track id: derived from the start/finish crossing position and direction, the lap length and the lap's total turning - a heuristic that separates chicane / no-chicane layouts on synthetic data but is unvalidated on real circuits. A new circuit is learned from two agreeing laps.
Retries without a loading screen (lap counter reset, time-of-day rewind, packet-id restart) start a new session.
Fuel unit conflicting (litres vs %): only the level / capacity fraction is reported.
Requires a heartbeat to the console (UDP 33739) every few seconds; telemetry arrives on UDP 33740.
Synthetic streams carry a marker in reserved bytes 0xD4..0xF3 and are flagged synthetic.

Retries without a loading screen (lap counter reset, time-of-day rewind, packet-id restart) start a new session.
Fuel unit conflicting (litres vs %): only the level / capacity fraction is reported.

notes: Implemented from Kunos' Remote Telemetry spec (field list) + observed sizes and two MIT clients (layout). PS5 (PS4 build), 2026-10-11: the probe script validated the protocol live (handshake answered, 14,356 RTCarInfo at 59.8 Hz, 0 rejected); this adapter is validated on that recorded capture (tests/recorded/test_ac_ps5_real.py: one lap crossing). pitwall's own client/service path, lap storage and coaching are still to be run on a full AC session.
pitwall must handshake with the game (UDP 9996) - nothing to configure in the game; re-registers per session.

Lap distance = spline position x track length: spline 0 is the line when the first crossing coincides with the spline wrap (PS5); the length is estimated after ~15-25 % of a lap from that crossing, then fixed by the first full lap (or known from an earlier session). Laps scaled by an unconfirmed estimate are void.
Steering is not mapped (unit undocumented). No tyre, fuel, sector, validity or weather data in the protocol.

The console's trackConfig repeats the track name: layouts of one track share a track id. Stored geometry of another layout is rejected by the first full lap's length check; references, comparisons and track models downstream are restricted to sessions of a compatible track length (within 3 %).
